nodes.label: Oficina Domain Language
nodes.rationale: Internal workshop operational system vocabulary used exclusively by Colaboradores.

nodes.label: Cliente
nodes.rationale: Person or company owning vehicles served by the workshop. Avoid: Client, customer, account.

nodes.label: Veículo
nodes.rationale: Car or motorcycle linked to a Cliente, identified by plate. Avoid: Carro, auto, automóvel as entity names.

nodes.label: Colaborador
nodes.rationale: Authenticated workshop team user. Avoid: User, usuário in the UI.

nodes.label: Ordem de Serviço
nodes.rationale: Vehicle service with lifecycle open/in-progress/completed/cancelled. Avoid: generic OS, ticket, job.

nodes.label: Checklist
nodes.rationale: Inspection tied to an Ordem de Serviço; items copied from a template at creation. Avoid: Formulário, loose inspeção, auto-check as entity.

nodes.label: Item de Checklist
nodes.rationale: Inspected point inside a Checklist with result and note. Avoid: Campo, pergunta.

nodes.label: Auto Check Araujo
nodes.rationale: Internal workshop MVP for Clientes and Veículos; stack Nuxt 4, Nuxt UI, Supabase Auth+Postgres+RLS.

nodes.label: pnpm Workspace allowBuilds
nodes.rationale: Allows native builds for better-sqlite3, core-js, esbuild, maplibre-gl, unrs-resolver, vue-demi.

nodes.label: Skills CLI (npx skills)
nodes.rationale: Package manager for agent skills: find, add, check, update; verify install count and source reputation before recommending.

nodes.label: Nuxt Framework Skill
nodes.author: Anthony Fu
nodes.rationale: Full-stack Vue with SSR, file-based routing, auto-imports, Nitro; based on Nuxt 4.x with app/ srcDir.

nodes.label: Nuxt 4 app/ srcDir
nodes.author: Anthony Fu
nodes.rationale: Default srcDir is app/; ~/@ point at app/; ~~/@@ for project root.

nodes.label: Nuxt Content Skill
nodes.rationale: Typed content-driven Nuxt apps via collections, queryCollection, and ContentRenderer.

nodes.label: Content v2 Migration
nodes.rationale: Replace queryContent with queryCollection; explicit catch-all page; ContentRenderer + mdc-unwrap.

nodes.label: Page Collection Type
nodes.rationale: Adds path, title, description, seo, body, navigation for one-file-one-route content.

nodes.label: Data Collection Type
nodes.rationale: Structured records with domain schema owned by the author.

nodes.label: Content Database Adapters
nodes.rationale: SQLite default; also d1, postgresql, libsql, pglite for deployment targets.

nodes.label: MDC Components
nodes.rationale: components/content/ available in Markdown/MDC; native slots with mdc-unwrap.

nodes.label: Nuxt SEO Skill
nodes.rationale: Meta-module bundling robots, sitemap, og-image, schema-org, site-config, seo-utils.

nodes.label: asSeoCollection()
nodes.rationale: Wraps Content collections for automatic sitemap, og-image, schema-org from frontmatter; load @nuxtjs/seo before @nuxt/content.

nodes.label: Satori OG Renderer
nodes.rationale: Default fast partial-CSS renderer; no display:grid; use flex; fonts via @nuxt/fonts global.

nodes.label: Schema.org Site Identity
nodes.rationale: defineOrganization or definePerson once in nuxt.config for site-wide JSON-LD identity.

nodes.label: nuxt-site-config / useSiteConfig()
nodes.rationale: Foundation shared config: url, name, description, defaultLocale, indexable, trailingSlash.

nodes.label: Nuxt Studio Skill
nodes.rationale: Self-hosted visual editor for Nuxt Content; owns editing/publishing while Content owns collections/queries/rendering.

nodes.label: Studio OAuth Providers
nodes.rationale: NUXT_STUDIO_AUTH_ prefix; GitHub/GitLab publish with provider token; Google needs separate Git token.

nodes.label: Studio Publish Cycle
nodes.rationale: Draft check → commit → Git provider write → CI/CD deploy → wait for Content DB catch-up; Git commit is the webhook.

nodes.label: Studio SSR Runtime Requirement
nodes.rationale: Studio needs server routes for auth; deploy with nuxt build to SSR-capable platform; content pages may still prerender.

nodes.label: Visual Editor (TipTap)
nodes.rationale: Converts Markdown/MDC to editable TipTap document

nodes.label: Schema Forms
nodes.rationale: Edit frontmatter and data files from Nuxt Content collection schema

nodes.label: Draft and Preview Model
nodes.rationale: Browser-local drafts overlay deployed Content DB; publishing commits to Git; drafts are per-browser-profile

nodes.label: NuxtHub Blob External Media
nodes.rationale: External uploads durable immediately and not part of Git draft

nodes.label: Studio AI Assistance
nodes.rationale: Treat generated text as editor draft; publish through same Git boundary

nodes.label: UApp Root Wrapper
nodes.rationale: Required for toasts, tooltips, and programmatic overlays

nodes.label: Always Use Semantic Colors
nodes.rationale: Never use raw Tailwind palette colors like text-gray-500

nodes.label: Theme Override Priority
nodes.rationale: Highest wins: ui/class prop → global config → theme defaults

nodes.label: Overlay Selection Matrix
nodes.rationale: Modal for focused/destructive; Slideover for details; Drawer for mobile; Popover contextual; Tooltip non-interactive

nodes.label: Feedback Selection Matrix
nodes.rationale: Toast for ephemeral action feedback; Alert for persistent inline; never toast for actionable info

nodes.label: Prefer Prose Over Generic UI in Markdown
nodes.rationale: Prose components styled for Markdown contexts; Comark auto-resolves when @nuxt/ui installed
nodes.norm_label: prefer prose over generic ui in markdown

nodes.label: Auto-registered Modules
nodes.rationale: Do not add @nuxt/icon, @nuxt/fonts, @nuxtjs/color-mode to modules array

nodes.label: Content After UI Module Order
nodes.rationale: @nuxt/content must come after @nuxt/ui or prose components unavailable

nodes.label: Component Variants
nodes.rationale: One solid primary button per view; destructive may use soft/outline unless primary on confirmation

nodes.label: Standard Schema Validation
nodes.rationale: Zod, Valibot, Yup, or Joi via UForm schema

nodes.label: Comark Streaming Markdown
nodes.rationale: Incrementally renders tokens and enables Nuxt UI prose components

nodes.label: Use #body Slot for Scrollable Content
nodes.rationale: Putting content directly in UDashboardPanel without #body breaks scrolling

nodes.label: Nested UPage Sidebars
nodes.rationale: Outer UPage handles left sidebar; inner UPage handles right — intentional nesting

nodes.label: UHeader #body Mobile Menu
nodes.rationale: Without #body slot, mobile users have no navigation

nodes.label: Prefer UAuthForm with UPageCard
nodes.rationale: Handles layout, providers, validation, and submit out of the box

nodes.label: Layer Priority Order
nodes.rationale: Project files > auto-scanned (Z>A) > extends array (first>last); numeric prefixes control order

nodes.label: createResolver
nodes.rationale: Use for all path resolution in modules

nodes.label: moduleDependencies
nodes.rationale: Prefer over installModule

nodes.label: Avoid Double Fetching with $fetch in Setup
nodes.rationale: $fetch alone in setup fetches twice; useFetch hydrates from payload
nodes.norm_label: avoid double fetching with $fetch in setup

nodes.label: useState Request Isolation
nodes.rationale: Module-level state leaks between requests on server; useState is request-isolated

nodes.label: Get Composables Before Await
nodes.rationale: Awaiting before composables may lose Nuxt context

nodes.label: runtimeConfig vs app.config
nodes.rationale: Use runtimeConfig for secrets and per-environment values; use app.config for public tokens, theme, and non-sensitive build-time config with HMR.

nodes.label: Avoid Double-Fetching
nodes.rationale: Do not use $fetch alone in setup for initial data—it fetches twice (server + client). Prefer useFetch or useAsyncData for SSR-safe hydration.

nodes.label: Deployment Platform Choice
nodes.rationale: Vercel for fastest DX; Netlify for static/forms; Cloudflare for cost/edge; GitHub Actions+VPS for full control.

nodes.label: Nuxt 4 Default Layout
nodes.rationale: Vue app code lives under app/; server/, shared/, public/, modules/, layers/, and nuxt.config.ts stay at project root.

nodes.label: Composable Context Rules
nodes.rationale: Nuxt composables must be called in valid context (script setup, setup(), plugins, route middleware)—not at module top level.

nodes.label: SSR-safe State
nodes.rationale: Do not define ref state outside setup—causes memory leaks and shared state across requests. Use useState for SSR-safe shared reactive state.

nodes.label: frozen-lockfile Flag
nodes.rationale: Always use in CI to fail if lockfile outdated and prevent supply-chain drift

nodes.label: Phantom Dependencies Handling
nodes.rationale: pnpm is strict — transitive imports must be declared explicitly in package.json

nodes.label: pnpm 11.x Alpha
nodes.rationale: Breaking: pure ESM, Node 18/19 dropped, .npmrc project configs move to packageConfigs in pnpm-workspace.yaml

nodes.label: Content-Addressable Store
nodes.rationale: Packages stored once globally and hard-linked into projects

nodes.label: pnpm Catalogs
nodes.rationale: Centralize dependency versions once; reduce merge conflicts and version drift

nodes.label: proto-picker Harness Chrome
nodes.rationale: Appearance is not a design decision — fixed dark glass pill so it never reads as part of the design under judgment

nodes.label: Picker Highlight Slide Animation
nodes.rationale: Highlight animates 250ms; variant swap stays instant per frequency rule

nodes.label: Variant Divergence Principle
nodes.rationale: Each variant must be a shippable direction on a named axis; three tints of the same idea waste the picker

nodes.label: Isolated Prototype Surface
nodes.rationale: Never touch production code during exploration; integrate only the chosen winner

nodes.label: Emil Kowalski Motion Standards in Prototypes
nodes.community_name: Emil Kowalski Motion Standards in Prototypes
nodes.norm_label: emil kowalski motion standards in prototypes

nodes.label: Verify Against Changelog Principle
nodes.author: supabase
nodes.rationale: Supabase changes frequently — do not rely on training data; check changelog and docs first

nodes.label: Never Use user_metadata for Authz
nodes.author: supabase
nodes.rationale: raw_user_meta_data is user-editable and unsafe in JWT/RLS — use app_metadata instead

nodes.label: SECURITY DEFINER Bypass Trap
nodes.author: supabase
nodes.rationale: Never add SECURITY DEFINER to fix permission errors — it silently removes access control

nodes.label: BOLA/IDOR via TO authenticated Alone
nodes.author: supabase
nodes.rationale: TO authenticated alone is auth without authorization — combine with ownership predicate

nodes.label: ESM-First Dual Format Principle
nodes.rationale: type:module with .mjs outputs; always support both CJS and ESM consumers

nodes.label: OIDC Provenance Release
nodes.rationale: Tokenless npm publish with GitHub OIDC — requires Node 24+, id-token:write, --provenance

nodes.label: @antfu/eslint-config Flat Config
nodes.rationale: Handles linting and formatting — replaces Prettier

nodes.label: package.json exports Field
nodes.rationale: Modern entry points for Node 12.7+; preferred over main/module/types alone

nodes.label: typesVersions Fallback
nodes.rationale: For older TypeScript versions without exports support

nodes.label: Export Condition Order
nodes.rationale: Order matters: put most specific first — types always first, then import, then require

nodes.label: sideEffects false Tree-Shaking
nodes.rationale: sideEffects:false enables tree-shaking by bundlers

nodes.label: pnpm Catalogs
nodes.rationale: Organize dependencies by purpose (build/lint/test/types/prod) from antfu's blog

nodes.label: Conventional Commits
nodes.rationale: Required for changelogen to generate changelogs from commits

nodes.label: npm OIDC Publishing
nodes.rationale: Recommended over token-based publishing; no NPM_TOKEN needed

nodes.label: npm Provenance
nodes.rationale: repository field required in package.json for npm provenance

nodes.label: Idempotency Testing
nodes.rationale: Ensure transforms are stable — second pass must not change output

nodes.label: Multi-TS Version Testing
nodes.rationale: TanStack pattern: matrix test across TypeScript versions

nodes.label: isolatedDeclarations
nodes.rationale: Faster DTS generation

nodes.label: verbatimModuleSyntax
nodes.rationale: Explicit import type required

nodes.label: moduleResolution Bundler
nodes.rationale: Use Bundler for libraries consumed by Vite/webpack; allows no extensions and exports field

nodes.label: moduleResolution Node16/NodeNext
nodes.rationale: Use Node16/NodeNext for Node.js-only libraries; requires explicit .js extensions

nodes.label: OIDC Release Workflow
nodes.rationale: Requires Node.js 24+, id-token:write, --provenance, repository field, Trusted Publisher

nodes.label: Vite Build Tool
nodes.author: Anthony Fu
nodes.rationale: Next-generation frontend build tool with fast ESM+HMR dev server; Vite 8 uses Rolldown+Oxc

nodes.label: Always Use ESM
nodes.author: Anthony Fu
nodes.rationale: Always use ESM, avoid CommonJS; prefer vite.config.ts

nodes.label: loadEnv in Config
nodes.rationale: .env files load after config resolution — use loadEnv to access them in config

nodes.label: Multiple Runtime Environments
nodes.rationale: Vite 6+ formalizes environments beyond implicit client/SSR split

nodes.label: Rolldown Bundler
nodes.rationale: Vite 8 replaces esbuild+Rollup with unified Rust-based Rolldown; 10-30x faster production builds

nodes.label: Vue 3.5+ Enhancements
nodes.rationale: -56% memory, 10x faster array tracking, new SSR features

nodes.label: defineModel Two-Way Binding
nodes.rationale: Replaces manual modelValue prop + update:modelValue emit; use required:true to prevent double-emit

nodes.label: Composable Core Rules
nodes.rationale: VueUse first; no async composables; top-level only; readonly exports; useState for SSR

nodes.label: Custom Directives
nodes.rationale: Use when behavior needs direct DOM access and cannot be achieved with components or composables

nodes.label: Directive Function Shorthand
nodes.rationale: Shorthand applies same behavior to mounted and updated hooks

nodes.label: Always Use .value on refs in Scripts
nodes.rationale: Forgetting .value causes silent failures; templates auto-unwrap
nodes.norm_label: always use .value on refs in scripts

nodes.label: Never Destructure reactive() Directly
nodes.rationale: Destructuring breaks reactive connection; use toRefs() or prefer ref()

nodes.label: No Side Effects in Computed Getters
nodes.rationale: Side effects break reactivity model; use watch for side effects
nodes.norm_label: no side effects in computed getters

nodes.label: Watcher Async Cleanup
nodes.rationale: Stale requests can overwrite newer data without AbortController cleanup

nodes.label: Props Are Read-Only
nodes.rationale: Mutating props breaks one-way data flow; emit to parent instead

nodes.label: Never Use v-if with v-for on Same Element
nodes.rationale: Vue 3 runs v-if first so loop variable is undefined; use computed filter or template wrapper
nodes.norm_label: never use v-if with v-for on same element

nodes.label: Provide/Inject Reactivity Gotcha
nodes.rationale: Pass the ref itself, not .value; provide must be called synchronously

nodes.label: shallowRef and markRaw for Performance
nodes.rationale: Avoid deep reactivity overhead on large data and third-party object instances

nodes.label: Provide / Inject
nodes.rationale: Pass data through component tree without prop drilling

nodes.label: Provide Mutations Best Practice
nodes.rationale: Keep mutations in provider; expose readonly state plus update functions

nodes.label: Symbol Keys for Provide/Inject
nodes.rationale: Recommended for libraries and large apps to avoid key collisions

nodes.label: ref()
nodes.rationale: Primary API for reactive state; works with any value type

nodes.label: reactive()
nodes.rationale: Only objects; cannot replace entire object; destructuring loses reactivity

nodes.label: computed()
nodes.rationale: Getters should be pure; prefer over methods for derived data due to caching

nodes.label: nextTick()
nodes.rationale: DOM updates are batched and asynchronous

nodes.label: Composable Tests
nodes.rationale: Call composables directly without mounting

nodes.label: Test Behavior Not Implementation
nodes.rationale: Skip Vue internals, third-party libs, and trivial getters

nodes.label: verbatimModuleSyntax
nodes.rationale: Enforces explicit type imports to avoid bundler issues

nodes.label: Pure Functions Rule
nodes.rationale: Same input same output; no side effects, refs, or API calls

nodes.label: Utils vs Composables Boundary
nodes.rationale: Stateful or Vue-specific logic belongs in composables, not utils

nodes.label: Chart Wall vs Workshop-Clean P1
nodes.rationale: High cognitive load from chart wall delays primary task; fix by putting OS list and counts first, charts secondary, closer to DESIGN §6.

nodes.label: Missing Home Error State P1
nodes.rationale: Composable error/refresh state never reaches the Home UI; add banner plus retry.

nodes.label: Operate Hierarchy Opportunity
nodes.rationale: Distill Home so list plus status come first and charts are secondary — answer which OS to open now.

nodes.label: Workshop-Clean Atmosphere
nodes.rationale: Practical metallic workshop cockpit: brand blue as sole action accent; no marketing fluff, purple neon, or decorative cards.

nodes.label: Public Sans and JetBrains Mono Typography
nodes.community_name: Public Sans and JetBrains Mono Typography
nodes.norm_label: public sans and jetbrains mono typography

nodes.label: Workshop Ledger Theme
nodes.rationale: Day number is the instrument like a home KPI; agenda is a workshop ledger with white surfaces on muted canvas and status bars — no empty 07–18 grid.

nodes.label: App Brand Mark Icon
nodes.rationale: Square favicon presents a single polished chrome sphere on a dark field as the browser/app identity mark; blue reflections add brand color without extra typography or logo text.
